## Looking for full transcript of video?Read now


The need for more flexible gear production is increasing more and more. In this video, Sandvik Coromant shows a complete offering for flexible gear production, for both inner and outer gear machining, using power skiving and their dedicated tooling solutions.


***This video was previously featured on Sandvik Coromant's***[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GtiA-0tjARE) ***channel.***
